title: packages/<id>/versions/<version>.json
description: One version of a package: where its archive is, and the archive's SHA-256. The file's name is the version.

url.description: Where the archive is published. Ends in <id>-<version>.nbtpkg, and serves the archive as it is.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the archive, as nbtpkg.py verify prints it.

channel.description: "prerelease" for a version that is not finished, which the app offers only to those who ask for pre-releases. With no channel the version is stable. A version whose name has a pre-release part, such as 1.4.0-beta.1, is always a pre-release.

notes.description: What is new, a line each.

source.description: The public repo and the commit the archive was built from.
